newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end flat, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end flat, seen volatile.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended slightly higher after dropping in early trade on Friday before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
"Uncertain economic condition is likely to keep the market volatile in the near term," Anisur Rehman, research head at SocGen-Crosby Securities, said.
Analysts say Pakistan has to repay debts worth about $1.6 billion during March-June while it has only $1.0 billion in cash reserves and an average monthly trade deficit of $250 million.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 0.60 points, or 0.04 percent, to end at 1,588.65.
Losers led gainers 226 to 64. Turnover fell to 35 million shares from Thursday's 59 million.
Bank of Punjab rose 0.50 to 28.50 rupees, Dewan Salman Fibre 0.20 to 41, Hub Power Co 0.25 to 37.75 and PTCL 0.55 to 30.20. ICI Pakistan fell 0.35 to 24.35 and Fauji Fertilizer 1.0 to 75.
